event_name: Super Grip NHRA Thunder Valley Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 78 degrees, relative humidity 66 percent, barometer 29.92 inches, adjusted
altitude 3,712 feet, track temperature 107 degrees.

Josh Hart beat Kalitta in the Final round at Gainesville this year. This (#11) is the lowest starting spot for
Doug Kalitta in his last 19 races.

Kalitta is 9 - 5 against Hart in prior events. 

Hart with the starting line advantage, but Kalitta had the difference made up by the time they went by the
Christmas tree and never trailed from there on for the win.  Kalitta with the second quickest pass of the
event for the win.

Hart with a hole out early, but stayed with it.

Tony Stewart is 31 - 16 in Rd. 1 races. In their 10 races Justin Ashley has "left first" 8 times.

Ashley and Stewart have each won 5 times against the other in prior events. 

Ashley with the starting line advantage, but had a hole out early.

Stewart had the diference made up by half track and never trailed from there on for the win.

Ashley with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

Antron Brown is #2 and the #2 TF qualifier is 14 - 10 in Rd. 1 at this event.  This is Will Smith's 11th
start.

This is the first time Smith and Brown have faced each other in eliminations. 

Smith with the starting line advantage, but Brown had the difference made up by the time they went by the
Christmas tree and never trailed from there on for the win.

Smith with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

Leah Pruett had had 6 Bye runs in her career and won the race three times.

Pruett launched hard and kept it hooked up to make the quickest pass of the event.  Leah Pruett's incremental
times: 60ft-0.840 sec., 330ft-2.155, 660ft-3.042/289.63 mph.

In his last 50 stars Tony Schumacher is 18 - 32 in Rd. 1.  Keith Murt is making his 6th start.

This is the first time Murt and Schumacher have faced each other in eliminations. 

Schumacher with the starting line advantage and the power to hold on for the hole shot win.  Tony Schumacher's
MOV: 0.0311 seconds (approximately 14 feet).  He will give up lane choice to Kalitta in the next round.

Murt with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

Billy Torrence is 12 - 3 in Rd. 1 when qualified #5. Maddi Gordon is 6 - 2 in Rd. 1 this year.

This is the first time Gordon and Torrence have faced each other in eliminations. 

Torrence with the starting line advantage, but just past half track the car started to spin the tires and drop
cylinders.

Gordon chased him down by the 1/8 mile mark and takes the win.  Gordon had a cylinder out, but still makes her
quickest pass of the weekend.  She will have lane choice over Stewart in the next round.

Shawn Reed is 0 - 6 against Millican in Rd. 1. In those 6 meetings Clay Millican "left first" every time. 

Millican is 7 - 2 against Reed in prior events. 

Millican with the starting line advantage, but then started to drop cylinders.  The car shuts off.

Reed grabs the lead just past the 330-foot mark and takes the win.  Reed is a tick off his qualifying tome for
the win.  He will give up lane choice to Brown in the next round.

This is Jasmine Salinas's 3rd race this year. She is 0 - 2 in her previous 2 starts. Shawn Langdon started
from the #9 spot in Chicago this year and won the race.

Langdon with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  Langdon kept it hooked up and makes
the quickest pass of the event.  Shawn Langdon's incremental times: 60ft-0.844 sec., 330ft-2.153,
660ft-3.041/291.57 mph.   Langdon will have lane choice over Pruett in the next round by 0.006 seconds.

Salinas starts to spin the tires and drop cylinders before she clicked it off.
